card: This pull request contains a complete prototype implementation of the Erlay transaction reconciliation protocol (BIP 330) using minisketch. It adds a new outbound reconciliation connection type alongside protocol message handlers to enable low-overhead transaction relay and improve eclipse resistance. The PR is explicitly designated as DO NOT MERGE by the author and is maintained as an integration branch while individual components are broken out into smaller pull requests.
changed_since_previous: Refactored the txreconciliation file layout and moved symbols into the node namespace, added logic to prune mempool-removed transactions from reconciliation sets, and added microbenchmarks for minisketch decoding at various capacities.
evidence: Erlay Project Tracking issue #30249 and Conceptual Discussion #34542 coordinate the ongoing effort to introduce BIP 330.

PR description: 'This approach uses Erlay as a fallback mechanism for transaction propagation... adds additional low-bandwidth connections to be used in case the node is being eclipsed. This connections should have minimal cost under normal circumstances, and only undergo real traffic in case other 8 full-outbound connections are being captured.'
PR description: 'This is not to be merged. Functionality will be spread across multiple smaller PRs to ease the review process.'
problem: Standard transaction relay floods inv announcements to all peers, consuming O(peers * txs) bandwidth and making it prohibitively expensive for nodes to open more outbound connections to defend against eclipse attacks. Today, nodes lack an efficient set-reconciliation fallback mechanism to maintain additional outbound peers with minimal bandwidth overhead.

risk.why: Flaws in P2P message parsing, peer eviction logic, or quadratic minisketch decoding could open remote denial-of-service vectors or partition nodes from transaction propagation.

scope_notes: Marked [DO NOT MERGE]; serves as a full-system prototype that is being split into a sequence of smaller PRs for review and merge.
summary: Implements the complete Erlay (BIP 330) transaction reconciliation protocol as an end-to-end reference and testing branch. It introduces an OUTBOUND_FULL_RECONCILIATION connection type for up to four additional low-bandwidth peers, adds handlers for the reqtxrcncl, sketch, reconcildiff, and reqsketchext P2P messages, and implements sketch generation, decoding, extension, and transaction announcement routines using minisketch. The branch is explicitly marked DO NOT MERGE and is intended to be split into smaller reviewable pull requests.
